column1: # shards.tsv — the langspec corpus split into CI shards, one line per
# (shards_test.go) keeps it complete and disjoint; `make test-langspec
# SHARD=n` runs one shard and the ci.yml matrix runs them in parallel.
# Tests that share a memoised walk (the two TestSpecProd*) stay together so
# the walk runs once. The heavy walks — the spec runner, the three checker
# ratchets, the real-program suites, the property fuzz — each anchor a
# shard of their own; the light pins fill in. Rebalance when one shard
# drifts past the others by more than a minute (`go test ./langspec -v
